$comment: Provenance and build input for the SHRI-Health module card photos. Run `npm run images` (client/) to download any missing original into originals/ (git-ignored) and regenerate public/images/shri-health/*.webp. To swap a photo, change its entry here and re-run; the output file names must stay the same.
